pages.title: Defense and response
pages.text: Native sleep rejects damage. Thrusts, side strikes and grabs require different movement: sidestep a thrust and leave a sweep’s reach. Avoid staying in front

pages.title: Ordinary combat
pages.text: This profile does not use hosted preparation. Fight it normally rather than looking for Start. Defeating this enemy contributes to world-tier progression.

pages.title: Loot and use
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Metal Debris, Somber Key Ring. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.
